neighbours.label: the token ' league' / ' League' in 'major league' / 'Major League' (professional baseball)
fire: Her grandfather pitched two seasons in major league baseball before the war.
Scouts from every Major League club came to watch the high school shortstop.
He hit his first major league home run off a veteran left-hander.
Only a handful of players from Montana have ever reached the major leagues.
The rookie signed a minor contract hoping to earn a Major League roster spot.
After the strike, attendance across Major League Baseball dropped sharply.
The catcher spent eleven years in the minors before his major league debut.
Few pitchers in major league history have thrown two no-hitters in one season.
quiet: Her grandfather pitched two seasons for a factory team before the war.
Scouts from every professional club came to watch the high school shortstop.
He hit his first home run in the big show off a veteran left-hander.

The rookie signed a minor contract hoping to earn a spot on the opening day roster.
